mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARDTYPE = 11
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND c.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE )
AND UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND (UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, sub.* FROM ( SELECT b.BOARDID AS boardId, b.BOARDTYPE AS boardType, b.BOARDTITLE AS boardTitle, b.BOARDCONTENT AS boardContent, b.BOARDNAME AS boardName, b.BOARDDATE AS boardDate, b.MEMNO AS memNo, NVL(b.BOARDVIEWCOUNT, 0) AS boardViewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND l.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND c.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS commentCount FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARDTYPE = 11
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND c.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE )
AND UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND (UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, b.BOARDID DESC
ORDER BY NVL(b.BOARDVIEWCOUNT, 0) DESC, b.BOARDID DESC
ORDER BY b.BOARDID DESC
) sub WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startRow}

SELECT b.BOARDID AS boardId, b.BOARDTYPE AS boardType, b.BOARDTITLE AS boardTitle, b.BOARDCONTENT AS boardContent, b.BOARDNAME AS boardName, b.BOARDDATE AS boardDate, b.MEMNO AS memNo, NVL(b.BOARDVIEWCOUNT, 0) AS boardViewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND l.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND c.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS commentCount FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARDID = #{boardId}

SELECT c.COMMENTSID AS commentsId, c.BOARDID AS boardId, c.BOARDTYPE AS boardType, c.COMMENTSCONTENT AS commentsContent, c.COMMENTSNAME AS commentsName, c.COMMENTSDATE AS commentsDate, c.COMMENTSNO AS commentsNo, c.MEMNO AS memNo FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = #{boardId} AND c.BOARDTYPE = 11 ORDER BY c.COMMENTSDATE ASC
